card.name: The word adjunct and adjuvant
card.fires_on: The word adjunct, adjunctive or adjuvant, on the word itself or on its early or late pieces, in drug-label text about add-on therapy.

modes.label: Start of adjuvant/adjunctive
modes.description: Responds to the first pieces of ad-ju-vant or Adj-unct-ive when the word is split.
modes.example: standard or escalated doses of cyclophosphamide (AC) ad<<ju>>vant chemotherapy and were followed for 6

modes.label: Whole word adjunct
modes.description: Responds to the whole word ' adjunct' after 'as an' or 'and'.
modes.example: ZURZUVAE can be used alone or as an<< adjunct>> to oral antidepressant therapy.

modes.label: Ending -ive
modes.description: Responds to the ending of Adjunctive in headings.

card.plain: It lights up on the word adjunct (or adjuvant), meaning add-on treatment used with another therapy.
